name: Kazarlis 10-unit aggregate UC/SUC with hot and cold startup costs

original_reference.authors: S. A. Kazarlis, A. G. Bakirtzis, V. Petridis
original_reference.title: A genetic algorithm solution to the unit commitment problem

GA10.uc.local_format: Unmodified upstream text; local hash normalizes CRLF/CR to LF before UTF-8 encoding

field_sources.pmin,pmax: GA10 pMin,pMax; MW; checked against Table 1
field_sources.cost_a,cost_b,cost_c: GA10 c,b,a: cost_a*p^2 + cost_b*p + cost_c*u, with p in MW and hourly costs in dollars
field_sources.startup_cost,cold_startup_cost: GA10 SCV hot:cold, checked against Table 1; dollars per startup
field_sources.cold_start_hours: Table 1 cold start hours; also GA10 second SCI breakpoint minus MinDown
field_sources.min_up,min_down: GA10 MinUp,MinDown; hours; checked against Table 1
field_sources.initial_duration: Table 1 initial status; signed hours, positive means on
field_sources.initial_output: Project assumption: Pmin for initially on units, zero otherwise; MW
field_sources.base_load: GA10 demands, hourly MW, same load sequence as Table 2
field_sources.ramp_up,ramp_down,pstart,pshut: Project choice: each equals Pmax, so no additional hourly ramp or startup/shutdown output restriction
field_sources.shutdown_cost: Project assumption: zero; no shutdown fee in the chosen benchmark

startup_rule.hot: startup after D <= L consecutive offline hours
startup_rule.cold: startup after D > L consecutive offline hours
startup_rule.history: Initial signed status supplies pre-horizon consecutive on/off hours; history is not reset at block boundaries
startup_rule.scenario_accounting: Shared commitment startup costs are charged once, outside scenario-weighted fuel costs

source_corrections: Use the explicit GA10 quadratic coefficients. The numerical quadratic row in the cross-check Table 1 is 1000 times larger; GA10 c equals that row times 1e-3. Unit 7 cost_a is 0.0079.
Do not import GA10 RU/RD/SU/SD additions (equal to Pmin); this project uses the classical version without extra ramp restrictions.
model_choices: Aggregate UC/SUC only; this is the Kazarlis 10-unit benchmark, not the original MATPOWER New England case39 grid.
Deterministic reserve is 10% of load. Stochastic factors 0.90/1.00/1.05, probabilities 0.25/0.50/0.25 and 5% reserve are project extensions.
Preserve the existing last-hour shutdown prohibition and horizon-truncated minimum up/down constraints; published optimal costs are not acceptance targets.
input_hash_format: SHA256 of UTF-8 text after CRLF/CR to LF normalization; all other whitespace is preserved
